newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bouygues Telecom in Ffr 15 bln loan talks.
newsitem.headline: Bouygues Telecom in Ffr 15 bln loan talks.

text.p: Bouygues Telecom, the telecommunications unit of French construction group Bouygues, is in talks to form a group to arrange a 15 billion francs loan, a Bouygues spokeswoman said on Monday.

"Bouygues Telecom has started negotiations with BNP, ABN Amro, JP Morgan and WestLB so these four banks can together form the arranging banks for the 15 billion franc credit which will be concluded between Bouygues Telecom and a bank syndicate," she said.
Market sources said the four banks will be the lead managers for the bank syndicate.
Bouygues Telecom said at the end of January that it would need the borrowing for the major part of its development plans, estimated at a total 23 billion francs.
